children.name: mac
children.role: Multiply-accumulate cell: registers o_result <= (i_data*i_weight)+i_pre_result and o_data_next <= i_data; instantiated 4x as mac_00/mac_01/mac_10/mac_11.

children.name: systolic_reg
children.role: Systolic skew aligner: out1 = in1 delayed 1 cycle (delay10); out2 = in2 delayed 2 cycles (delay20 -> delay21).

children.name: fifo
children.role: 8-entry 32-bit pointer-based single-clock FIFO with combinational read; instantiated 3x as fifo_00/fifo_01/fifo_result.

children.name: tpu_top
children.role: Top integration: instantiates the 4 MACs, systolic_reg and 3 FIFOs; holds inline the APB-style register file (weight load + result read-back), the start/counter control FSM, result routing mux, and done generation.
